scenicChapters.title: Uganda Kigezi Highlands Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 15 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

scenicChapters.title: Uganda Kigezi Highlands Road
scenicChapters.narrative: For 47 km this is Uganda Kigezi Highlands Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

uganda-kigezi-highlands-road.story: 111 km one way from Kabale - plan on about 1 h 54 of riding. The stops in between: Lake Bunyonyi and Kisoro. The highest point is about 2,200 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
